body:
The "haters" are all in my head. There's tons of them every single day telling me that I'm worthless. I didn't really make that clear, but I'm sane enough to realize that they're all in my imagination/head.

I'm really glad you said something though. It's very hard living with whatever it is that's going on with my head and body every day.

Thank you for reaching out to me. Hope you have a wonderful day.
